text:
maya: scheduling the Cedar dedicated slice rollout for tonight 22:30-23:30 UTC. customer requested version pin and a clear rollback path. release notes: https://redwood.co/releases/cedar-2026-03-20

sam: confirming: canary will be 10% traffic on slice-3, model pin `rwd-v2.3-dedicated`. no infra changes, just image `rwd-inference:v2.3`.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket #DL-8421 created. Canary job started for cedar slice-3 at 22:30 UTC when you mark greenlight. Logs will stream to /deployments/cedar/8421.

liam: SRE guardrails: abort if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency degrades >20% vs baseline. fallback target: `rwd-v2.2-stable`. Playbook: https://intranet.redwood/sre/playbooks/rollback.md

anya: FYI from CS: Cedar legal needs a one-hour maintenance window and SLA notice sent. Keep error budget under 1% or they escalate.

ops-oncall: how do we trigger rollback manually? want the exact CLI in playbook.

sam: manual rollback command in playbook snippet:
```
redwoodctl rollout abort --customer cedar --slice 3 --target-model rwd-v2.2-stable --reason "rollback-trigger"
redwoodctl rollback --customer cedar --slice 3 --from-job DL-8421
```
Also auto-fallback is enabled to `rwd-v2.2-stable` if deploy-bot receives `canary_health: fail` from monitoring.

deploy-bot: Running quick smoke checks: p50 12ms p95 78ms errors 0.03% (sample 2k reqs). canary progress 10% -> steady.

maya: thanks. @liam can you own the watch and metric thresholds for the window? @ops-oncall pls have the rollback CLI ready. I'll send the customer notice and pin the release in our console. Greenlight? :eyes:

liam: on it. watching dashboards, will call abort if thresholds breaching.

ops-oncall: ready with CLI. will run abort if alerted.

maya: greenlight given for 22:30-23:30 UTC. scheduling in Calendar and updating ticket. will post final status after full roll to 100%. :rocket:
